role: italic propositional random variables
notes: Source note2 distinguishes italic variables from roman value events.

role: positive value events of the corresponding variables
notes: Roman script is the source's value notation; negation denotes the other binary value.

role: specified joint probability law
notes: Every computation fixes one law; reported empirical judgments are not identified with it without a model.

role: posterior law after specified learning
notes: Distinct from the prior and from an intervention law.

role: complement of a probability parameter equal to one minus x
notes: Published source shorthand; not event negation or algebraic closure.

role: set of parent variables of a node
notes: Source parent-set notation; empty at a root.

role: normalized local mass table at each parent assignment
notes: Tables on null parent strata are stipulated entries rather than conditionals on null events.

role: joint conditional independence of variable tuples
notes: Conditionals refer to positive conditioning strata; semigraphoid operations are proved.

role: binary collider prior and conditional probability parameters
notes: Published source collider table; a later report randomization parameter has its explicit local definition.

role: directed posterior-to-prior Kullback Leibler divergence
notes: Direction and zero conventions are explicit; not a metric.

role: parameters of the finite conditional-constraint minimization
notes: Locally defined in the stated positive four-cell law; not latent empirical process parameters.

role: prior and evidence likelihoods with inverse likelihood ratio q over p
notes: The source uses the inverse ratio; x is only defined when p is positive.

role: false-positive and false-negative rates
notes: Their event definitions are retained separately from the posterior hypothesis probability.

role: italic reliability and report variables
notes: Published source symbols; roman script specifies their positive value events.

role: positive reliability and positive report events
notes: Not the variables themselves; event negation denotes their negative values.

role: source reliability and unreliable-source positive-report probability
notes: The source's reliable-or-randomizing model is a stated idealization.

role: two-positive-report likelihoods in separate and shared reliability models
notes: Report independence is conditional on the specified parents rather than unconditional.

role: count variable mediating hypothesis and search outcome
notes: Finite suitable-alternative count in NAA; finite or countable good-argument count in NRF.

role: value event that the mediator count is i
notes: Mutually exclusive exhaustive events; zero-weight values are permitted.

role: mediator mass and conditional hypothesis and search-failure table entries
notes: On null mediator strata h_i and f_i are specified table entries not ordinary conditional probabilities.

role: search-outcome variable and its positive failure-to-find event
notes: Unsuccessful search differs from nonexistence; P of the positive event must exceed zero for conditioning.

role: expertise and honesty variables with their root probabilities
notes: Local extension distinguishes informed deceit from ignorance; not Hartmann's binary reliability variable.
